name: Ловля фігури (4)
description: A trapped piece has no chance of escape and becomes an easy target. When the mobility of a piece is restricted, it risks being trapped. Trapped pieces have no escape squares. By attacking them, you can win material.

texts: Pieces with limited mobility can be trapped.
